title: Oyakodon (Japanese Chicken and Egg Rice Bowl)
summary: A comforting Japanese rice bowl topped with chicken, onion, and softly set eggs simmered in a savory-sweet dashi sauce.

steps.description: Cut 250g chicken thigh into bite-size pieces and thinly slice 1/2 onion. Lightly break the yolks of 3 eggs with chopsticks, leaving streaks of white. Slice the optional spring onion.
Bring 150ml water, 1/2 tsp instant dashi, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp mirin, and 1 tsp sugar to a simmer in a small pan. Add the onion and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes.

Spread the chicken evenly over the onion, cover, and simmer for about 5–7 minutes until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of at least 74°C. Reduce the heat if the sauce evaporates too quickly.
Pour in two-thirds of the eggs in a circular motion and cook 30 seconds. Add the rest, cover, and gently cook for 1–2 minutes until softly set; cook longer if you prefer fully set eggs.
Divide 2 bowls of warm rice between serving bowls and spoon half the chicken, egg, onion, and broth over each. Scatter with optional spring onion and serve immediately.
